title: ExportRequest
description: Body of POST /api/projects/{p}/models/{m}/export (plan/EXPORT_PLAN.md P-EX1, W-EX1): the model document to export as a C/FMU, an optional subsystem scope (J-EX11) and the export settings (D-EX7). The backend runs it in a Julia process of its own and then builds the FMU.

scope.description: Instance path of the subsystem to export alone (D-EX9 scope): its ports become the interface and everything outside it is dropped. Null or absent exports the whole model, whose interface is its Export markers.

powerInputs.description: For each scalar power port of the scope, the variable the host imposes: effort (input <port>_e, output <port>_f) or flow (input <port>_f, output <port>_e). Every power port of the scope needs an entry (E112).

inputValues.description: Start value of a scope input, by port name (default 0). For a power port it is the start of the imposed variable.

settings.title: ExportSettings
settings.description: The export settings of the dialog. Null or absent means automatic: the exporter chooses (D-EX7) and the report shows the numbers.

method.title: ExportMethod
method.description: The integrator; auto picks the cheapest method that meets the step rule (a Rosenbrock method for a DAE).

dt.description: Internal step in seconds (whole nanoseconds, dividing the communication step); null chooses it from the spectrum.

step.description: Communication step in seconds (FMI DefaultExperiment stepSize); null is 1 ms, or finer for horizons below 0.5 s.

damping.description: The Rosenbrock step rule's damping; null is the default 0.05 with the over-budget fallback to 0.5 (W214). A set value turns the fallback off.

jacobian.title: ExportJacobian
jacobian.description: Rosenbrock only: the Jacobian in C (symbolic, coloured finite differences, or auto).

linearSolver.title: ExportLinearSolver
linearSolver.description: Rosenbrock only: dense LU, static sparse LU, or auto (sparse above 40 states).

exposeAll.description: Debug option: publish every recorded signal as a read-only local variable. It does not change the interface.
